title: Paul McCartney live: Cheese & Grain, Frome | 2022
content:
Paul McCartney played a Glastonbury Festival warm-up show at the Cheese & Grain in Frome, Somerset, on Friday 24 June 2022.

It was the 17th show of the Got Back Tour, which lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025. The performance took place the evening before McCartney’s headlining set at Glastonbury Festival’s Pyramid Stage.

? @paulmccartney Live in Frome? Tomorrow night at 5pm? OK then! ? Tickets are available now from our box office in person only. First come, first served.https://t.co/sdAU8Tdbq1 pic.twitter.com/hxVTzjIsXi

— Cheese and Grain (@cheeseandgrain) June 23, 2022

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).

The Cheese & Grain gig was announced just before 5pm on Thursday 23 June, with tickets on sale for just £25 only in person at the venue box office. All tickets were sold within an hour.

SOLD OUT. Thank you Frome ? pic.twitter.com/uFZwv6rbld

— Cheese and Grain (@cheeseandgrain) June 23, 2022
